correctness.rationale: For smooth Ciani quartics, the 2K and 3K Wronskians are invariant odd-degree sections divisible by the reduced 36-point involution-axis divisor B. The invariant even-degree residuals reduce to U^9P2(t) and U^33P3(t), with quotient t=V/U^3 of degree 24. The modular a=1, characteristic-1009 certificate gives degree(P3)=11, gcd(P3,P3prime)=1, all branch values avoided, and gcd(P2,P3)=1. These are nonzero algebraic open conditions over characteristic zero; Riemann–Hurwitz and the quotient degree establish exactly eleven simple free size-24 orbits, plus the 36 simple fixed-axis zeros. No numerical or finite sampling is substituted for the group-invariant degree argument.

value.rationale: This is a complete, naturally motivated generic higher-Weierstrass orbit classification for the standard one-dimensional S4-symmetric genus-three quartic family, refining the universal total-weight count into 14 exact orbits and identifying absence of overlap with second-order Weierstrass points off symmetry axes. It contrasts with the published special a=3 member, where 252 distinct third-order points include multiplicity-five hyperflexes, making the generic/special deformation of the divisor mathematically relevant.
